completion_rule: Each confirmation needs date, exact scope, source/role, evidence and permission to publish; record conflicts. Founder editorial acceptance is separate. Web directory lookup is not contact or inspection.

guides.title: Bhubaneswar
guides.evidence_needed: Name the chosen site and visitor eligibility; describe entrance, steps, seated breaks and usable toilet; record pickup and return points.
guides.remaining: Site-by-site entry eligibility, access, toilets, transport and opening arrangements need local verification.

guides.title: Dhauli
guides.evidence_needed: Confirm whether the show runs on a named date, booking channel and cancellation; describe approach, steps, seating and return pickup.
guides.remaining: Current show operation, tickets, approach, steps, toilets and accessible routes remain unverified.

guides.title: Konark
guides.confirmation_role: ASI site/museum administration; festival organiser separately
guides.evidence_needed: Confirm monument and museum access separately, current closure days and tickets; any festival claim needs that year’s published programme.
guides.remaining: Ticket purchase not exercised; current museum opening, festival schedule, route access and facilities remain unverified.

guides.title: Puri
guides.confirmation_role: Temple administration; transport provider; lifeguard on the day
guides.evidence_needed: Confirm visitor eligibility, allowed belongings and entrance; check actual train and transfer separately; shore conditions must be checked on the day.
guides.remaining: Temple entry rules, facilities, crowd conditions and shore conditions need current official/local confirmation.

guides.title: Raghurajpur
guides.confirmation_role: Named maker who consents to a visit
guides.evidence_needed: Record agreed date, time, fee, photography and preferred credit; describe access and toilets only with the host’s confirmation or observation.
guides.remaining: Named maker, appointment, demonstration fee, facilities and accessible approach remain unverified.

guides.title: Coastal food
guides.evidence_needed: Record the dish, ingredients, preparation and menu date; separate Mahaprasad arrangements from restaurant service. Never infer dietary suitability.
guides.remaining: No restaurant, live menu, dietary suitability, preparation conditions or Mahaprasad arrangements verified.

guides.title: Coastal bases
guides.confirmation_role: Named property; first-hand inspection for recommendations
guides.evidence_needed: Record exact room/location, steps, bathroom access, meals, transfers, total price and cancellation terms. Separate proprietor claims from inspected experience.
guides.remaining: No named property, room, transport availability, access, noise level or booking terms inspected.
